architecture_principles: Prefer existing repository boundaries and the smallest coherent change.
Keep durable workflow state separate from disposable orchestration context.
testing_guidance: Add focused coverage for changed behavior and preserve repository-required validation.
documentation_guidance: Update repository documentation when topology, authority, or operator behavior changes.
invariants: Do not broaden approved scope without explicit authorization.
Do not weaken exact validation-policy reconciliation.
anti_patterns: Do not persist explorer transcripts, retries, or fan-out bookkeeping in workflow state.
Do not duplicate repository policy guidance in reusable agent contracts.
